case_number: 2024 INSC 465; Civil Appeal No. 7230 of 2024 @ Special Leave Petition (C) No. 5239 of 2024

parties.respondent: Sony Pictures Films India Private Limited & Ors

summary: Right to dignity vs freedom of speech; stereotyping disabled persons as comic relief violates Article 19(1)(a) reasonable restrictions; CBFC must apply RPwD Act 2016 disability-inclusive guidelines; 'Aankh Micholi' misrepresents conditions (nyctalopia, hemeralopia, Alzheimer's); derogatory terms condemned ('bhulakkad baap', 'soundproof system'); certification process flawed; High Court dismisses maintainability; film's portrayal reinforces prejudice against disabled community.
legal_provisions_cited: Cinematograph Act, 1952 s.3, s.4, s.5A, s.5B(2), s.8
Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; directions issued to CBFC for mandatory inclusion of disability expert in certification process; film required to display advisory against stereotyping.
